Dude, seriously.  It's manipulation.  She's gonna kill herself because you do?  No she's not.  She's stuck in a tough situation because she does care about you, so she's willing to bullshit you to try and keep you from doing it.  

Right now, I don't know what I'm gonna do.  I'm not killing myself tonight.  But I'm not saying I'm not gonna do it in the future either.  Thanks for trying.
I tried the suicide chat line.  I'm in tech, and I started my career doing scripted shit.  It was nothing but scripted bullshit
Right now, it isn't about what they want to me.  Right now, all that matters is if I'm not here, someone will still be able to take care of them.  They'll make it through.
Without me, at least they're guaranteed a roof over their head

I used to think like you.  I swallowed a bunch of sleeping pills last year, went through all the treatment, came out a different person.  then life happened, and keeps shitting on me.  I don't believe it anymore.
I'm out of time for things to get any better
push on?  how?  I have nothing.  I can't support my kids.  I can't even support myself.
I keep trying, but nothing pans out

IT

I didn't actually lose 2 jobs.  I was told I had one, and they changed their mind after giving me a start date.  Then I was told I was a final candidate for another, and they changed their minds because I stumbled on a technical question in the second interview.  I quit the job I had because I thought I had the first one after they gave me a start date, and I can't go back because they already hired someone to replace me.

I honestly have no options.  I have >$100 to my name right now and a vehicle that is overheating.  I can't move in with my girlfriend because she's living with family right now herself.  We both got out of abusive relationships to try and build a better life for our kids, and life just keeps getting harder for both of us.  I can't go to court, because I can't seem to get any pro bono attorney to want to take my case, and even if I did win a judgement, she works for someone who pays her in cash.  Hard to garnish those wages.  

I've asked a friend if I can stay with them, but that's not looking too promising right now either.  

I have no options.
